dialogue_texts: Muh huh huh... Did you think all of my attacks were enough? You're already witnessing the rebirth of the Order...
This sensation... the boundaries are thinning, but not by hand.
Your chaos was a temporary stain on the Order.
To think I would be outmaneuvered in my own garden...
Under the light of the next day, you will find no place to hide.
So this is how it ends... My very existence is being overwritten by glohm. Reimu... everyone... I'm sorry.
You have failed to choose a reality, and society will now abandon you. You are now a resident of the Order.
I will learn to control your soul soon enough. The Order's power is not yet fully restored, but it will come in time.
If you will become my faithful servant, I will not harm you.
Too bad! Bad ending! To see the good ending, clear the game without using a continue or letting nine hours pass.
